_doc: Place pages (plugins/place-pages). enabled: off stops the sweep. min_stop_minutes: a stop counts from this long. lookback_days: each morning re-sweeps this many complete days, so later corrections reach the pages. since: the earliest day ever swept (null: the whole archive). settled_sources: the ways a day names a stop that count as known (the user named it, it was booked, a saved place, the sign in a photo…). guess_sources and guess_min_confidence: map guesses that count when this confident; their visits say 'name from the map'. exclude_names: the user's own homes and properties, by the name the day gives them; never a page. same_name_radius_m: the same name within this distance is the same place (code); same_place_radius_m: a different name this close is put to the model as maybe the same place. excluded_labels: photo-library labels that keep a photo off a page (documents, receipts). cover_avoid_labels: labels that make a photo a worse cover (people). max_photos_on_page: the most photos drawn on one page (the rest are counted). batch_size: new places per model call. sonnet_budget: Sonnet escalations per run. thumb_fetch_limit: the most missing thumbnails exported from the photo library per run.
